videos.description:

I tested 3D prints from level 1 all the way to level 100, starting with a print-in-place dragon egg and ending with the hardest builds on the internet: a motorized Iron Man helmet, a light-up Zelda fire sword, real 3D printed shoes I sprinted in, an airless basketball, dragon scale armor, a working trombone, a precision gyroscope, and a tensegrity structure that floats. If you love 3D printing and the coolest things to 3D print, this is the ultimate level 1 to 100 3D printer challenge.
